summary: La Union 2nd District representative with 90 principal-authored bills. Authored a national taxpayer advocate office, National Internal Revenue Code amendments, a lifeline electricity rate for minimum-wage earners, abolition of the travel tax and the date of the first Bangsamoro parliamentary elections. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Travel-tax abolition is a widely co-sponsored bill with little signal. Mostly consumer and taxpayer-protection items.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored lifeline electricity rate for minimum-wage earners (-2) and co-authored national minimum wage (-2), against travel tax abolition and taxpayer-rights tax bills (+1).
